messages:
ravi.docs: FYI I'm consolidating the SOC2 audit-log page and adding a small migration note for renamed retention presets. Found two issues: a broken example link for our C# SDK and the wording around cross-border backups is a bit strong. Can legal + eng quick-check?

olga.legal: Good catch. Recommend softer language: "Audit logs are retained per tenant-configured retention settings. In limited cases where copies are maintained across regions for disaster recovery, the same retention and access controls apply and are governed by the tenant's key management and residency settings."

mike.eng: Confirmed. Replication is DR-only for tenants without residency enforcement; replicas inherit TTL metadata so they expire with the original retention. When copying across regions we re-encrypt with the tenant CMK if provided, otherwise our managed key is used.

sara.prod: Product asks: can we include two tiny examples mapping old numeric presets to new names (30d -> brief, 365d -> long) and a one-line Console tooltip copy? UX wants: "Presets map to recommended retention windows; see docs for residency and KMS details."

ravi.docs: Draft bullets: - Preset "brief" (30 days) — stored in-region by default; no replication by default.
- Preset "long" (365 days) — may be replicated for DR purposes; replicas observe the same TTL and access controls.

C# SDK snippet (point to example in repo):
```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_KEY"), region: "eu-west-1");
// uses customer-managed KMS in region when configured
var export = client.AuditLogs.Export("tenant-42", 365);
Console.WriteLine(export.Url);
```

olga.legal: tiny edit: replace "no replication by default" with "no replication unless configured for DR". Also add a short sentence telling customers to contact Sales for Private deployments with strict residency.

mike.eng: I'll add a redirect for the old C# example path and drop a README note. ETA today.

pr-bot: PR opened by ravi.docs - docs/audit-retention: add preset migration table, soften cross-region wording, fix C# SDK example link (PR #1204) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1204

sara.prod: Thanks team — I'll queue the Console tooltip update. ravi, please ping when PR merges and I'll add the UX task.

ravi.docs: will do. Closing thread after merge.
